subject: Next steps & risk tracker for FinVox trial: success criteria and escalation path
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@finvox.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & risk tracker for FinVox trial: success criteria and escalation path

Hi Nora,

Thanks for the demo today — good conversation. Recap below and proposed plan for the 3-week trial starting Monday 2026-05-24.

Success criteria (proposed):
- End-to-end ingest of sample dataset (50k rows) within 6 hours without >2% error rate.
- 95th percentile latency for inference < 300ms for 512-token requests.
- No unauthorized data exposures; audit log capture for all requests.

POC milestones & owners:
- Week 0 (setup) by 2026-05-24: onboarding + dataset snapshot (FinVox: Nora)
- Week 1 (ingest & baseline): validate ingest pipeline (Redwood owner: Sean)
- Week 2 (scale & regression): run 5k concurrent inference tests (Redwood owner: Monica)
- Acceptance review: 2026-06-14 (joint)

Known risks & immediate mitigations (tracked below):
1) Ingest API rate limits — potential partial uploads. Mitigation: retry with backoff + temporary batch window. Owner: Sean
2) Model quantization variance — may affect top-k retrieval. Mitigation: run side-by-side baseline on CPU for parity.

Please see attached "finvox_poc_mop_v1.xlsx" (POC plan + test matrix). Can you confirm the dataset snapshot timing and whether Prod Ops will provide elevated ingest quota for the initial run?

Next steps:
- Nora: confirm dataset snapshot window (by EOD Fri)
- FinVox Prod Ops: provide temporary quota or let us know constraints
- Sean/Monica: prepare canary config and test harness (ETA Tue 05/26)

Thanks,

Jasmine Liu
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0142

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clear plan. Quick notes:
- We can provide a dataset snapshot on Monday 5/24 at 09:00 PT.
- Prod Ops flagged a potential issue: our ingest gateway recently returned intermittent 502s during large multipart uploads (attached logs). If your client retries aggressively it may worsen backpressure.
- Regarding quota: we can temporarily raise the per-minute ingest limit for the trial window but need to coordinate a ramp.

I'll ask Prod Ops to provide the temp quota and their preferred ramp schedule.

Nora

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & risk tracker for FinVox trial: success criteria and escalation path

Thanks for the log, Nora — looks like gateway 502s correlate with bursts of 8+ parallel part uploads.

Immediate mitigation plan (short term):
- We'll add client-side rate limiting + exponential backoff in the trial agent for uploads (implement by Monday AM). Owner: Sean
- We'll enable a small ingest buffer/proxy to coalesce parts where possible to reduce spikes. Owner: Markus
- If gateway 502s persist after mitigation, escalate to FinVox Prod Ops incident channel and open dedicated support bridge.

I've created Jira ticket INFR-912 to track this (link below). If we can't get reliable ingest within 48 hours of the snapshot, we'll pause large-scale runs and continue smaller, controlled runs to gather latency baselines.

Escalation path:
- T+24h: Redwood infra lead (Markus Klein) + FinVox Prod Ops on call
- T+48h: Redwood VP Eng (request escalation to executive sponsor)

I'll push a branch with the retry logic and a small harness so we can run a 10k-row smoke test ahead of the full 50k run.

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
